text: BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit for DeepSeek Harness 是 DSH 插件配置包，使用 DSH 已有的 MCP 客户端连接 BaizhiCloud 托管服务。它通过 Streamable HTTP 和 BAIZHI_API_KEY Bearer 凭据接入，并让服务动态提供的 MCP 工具可供 DSH 调用。适合希望从 DSH 使用 BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit 的用户；需要 BaizhiCloud 账户、API key 和网络连接，工具输入会发送至 BaizhiCloud。

BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit for DeepSeek Harness connects DSH's MCP client to BaizhiCloud over Streamable HTTP, using a BAIZHI_API_KEY bearer credential. The service's offered tools become available to DSH. A BaizhiCloud account, API key, and network access are required; tool inputs go to BaizhiCloud.
想让 DSH 通过 MCP 连接 BaizhiCloud 的 Agent Toolkit。
需要在 DSH 里调用 BaizhiCloud 提供的远程工具。
I want to access BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit tools from my DSH profile.
BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit 的功能「MCP 工具接入」：通过 DSH 既有 MCP 客户端连接 BaizhiCloud，并以 BAIZHI_API_KEY 认证，使远端工具可供 DSH 调用。
BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit 会接收经 MCP 发出的工具输入，例如查询和 URL；这些请求发往 agent-toolkit.app.baizhi.cloud。（见 cordis.patch.yml:8-10）
连接需要非空的 BAIZHI_API_KEY；配置将其作为 Bearer 凭据发往 BaizhiCloud MCP 服务。（见 cordis.patch.yml:4,10）

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit for DeepSeek Harness：An optional community configuration bundle for the hosted [BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit](https://baizhi.cloud/landing/agent-toolkit). It loads DSH's existing MCP client with the service's Streamable HTTP endpoint and an API-key bearer header. It adds no transport, backend implementation, credential store, or default model provider.

This contribution is part of integration and promotion work for BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit; it is not an official DeepSeek integration.
section: BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit for DeepSeek Harness

text:
dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **0.1.5-rc.2** and pnpm on PATH. The MCP peer dependency is pinned to the tested release; compatibility with 0.1.6 alpha or later versions has not been established.
- Your own BaizhiCloud Agent Toolkit account and API key, available as `BAIZHI_API_KEY` in the DSH process environment. Review service pricing before calling tools. Keep the key out of Git, patches, and shared logs.
- An existing DSH profile with the standard tools runtime and network access to `https://agent-toolkit.app.baizhi.cloud/mcp`.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Install in your chosen profile：From a reviewed checkout of this bundle:

```sh
npm pack --ignore-scripts
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit-0.1.0.tgz --ignore-scripts
```

Replace `web` with the profile you actually use. DSH installs the package in that profile and adds its declared bundle to the profile's layer list. There is no build or install hook. Package installation alone does not authenticate the hosted service.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Install in your chosen profile：Provide `BAIZHI_API_KEY` using your normal environment/secret mechanism, then restart the selected profile. Missing, empty, or whitespace-only values disable this bundle entry, so it makes no connection until a nonempty key is available. A supplied value is trimmed before use in `Authorization: Bearer …`.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Install in your chosen profile：The MCP client discovers the service's current tool catalog dynamically. DSH namespaces tools as `mcp__baizhi__<remote-tool-name>`. Review the actual offered tools and requested operation before approving calls; this bundle does not restrict the service to search/read or promise that every exposed tool is read-only.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Install in your chosen profile：A first task after connecting: **Find the official Model Context Protocol transport documentation, read the relevant page, and summarize it with source links.** Success means the tool returned useful content and the linked sources support the summary. A visible configuration entry, local test, or discovered catalog alone is not production acceptance.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Data, failures, and removal：Tool inputs, including search queries, URLs, and any other approved arguments, are sent to BaizhiCloud. Calls may incur charges. This is static API-key bearer authentication, not OAuth. Service access and tool availability depend on your account.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Data, failures, and removal：If tools are absent, check whether the selected profile loaded this bundle and whether its process has a nonempty key. Connection/authentication failures do not intentionally stop the rest of the profile (`failOnStartupError: false`); the existing MCP client's reconnect behavior still applies. A 401 requires correcting account/key access, not installing another login wrapper.

To remove it from a profile:

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Data, failures, and removal：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.2 plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit
```

Restart the profile afterwards. Removing a local bundle does not revoke a remote API key; manage keys in your BaizhiCloud account.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Validation and scope：Six tests use the actual published DSH profile/bundle loader, Cordis lifecycle, tools registry, and MCP client against a loopback HTTP fixture with synthetic credentials. They cover initialize, tool discovery, registry dispatch, bearer rejection, missing/empty/whitespace credentials, and disposal. The test runner isolates HOME and environment; it overrides only the endpoint and reconnect policy inside the test profile and never calls the production endpoint. Disposal checks stream closure, tool unregistration, and no reconnect; it does not claim server-side session deletion.

dsh-plugin-baizhi-agent-toolkit README · Validation and scope：The tests do not exercise a live BaizhiCloud account, model, web UI, production billing, every operating system, or newer DSH releases. The public integration project and this MIT configuration bundle do not make the hosted backend open source. This is an independent community integration, not an official DeepSeek endorsement.
